diversity_analysis.ensemble_gain: weighted-soft macro-F1 minus best individual member macro-F1 on reddit_test

prediction_dependence.measure: Pearson correlation of paired binary correctness indicators
prediction_dependence.reported_for: all T-R, T-C, R-C member pairs within each seed triplet

metric_semantics.balanced_accuracy: mean recall across the six fixed Ekman classes
metric_semantics.macro_f1: unweighted mean of six Ekman class F1 values

no_outcome_adaptation: no rerunning seeds because of observed performance
no changing aggregation rule because of observed performance
no changing metric definitions because of observed performance
no changing bootstrap seed or replicate count because of observed performance
no selecting among the three platform seed triplets

platform_jury.equal_soft_definition: arithmetic mean of three six-class probability vectors followed by argmax
hard_vote_tie_break: among tied classes choose the class with greatest equal-soft mean probability
if still tied choose earliest class in fixed EKMAN order
platform_jury.plain_hard_definition: one vote per juror predicted class; choose majority class
platform_jury.weighted_hard_definition: sum each juror validation weight onto its predicted class; choose maximum class score
platform_jury.weighted_soft_definition: weighted arithmetic mean of six-class probability vectors followed by argmax

timing_statement: Part C was pre-specified in the original protocol. This execution-time analysis specification resolves remaining implementation details before any Part-C model-performance outcome is observed.

effect_sizes_with_ci: weighted-soft jury macro-F1 gain over best member
uncertainty.reddit_test_resampling_unit: example; R_clean test contains one target example per test author, so example resampling is equivalent to author-cluster resampling for this test set
